title: Camp Abroad Calculator
oneLiner: A childcare arbitrage calculator for parents comparing local summer camps, overseas programs, travel, work coverage, and social pressure.
targetUser: Working parents in high-cost cities planning summer childcare under budget and schedule pressure.
keyUX: Parents compare weekly camp cost, commute burden, travel cost, working-hour coverage, waitlist odds, passport needs, and status vs sanity tradeoffs in one decision room.
requiredUISections: Family summer calendar with uncovered workdays highlighted.
Camp comparison table for local, overseas, public, private, and shared-care options.
True-cost calculator with tuition, travel, gear, commute, meals, and missed work.
Parent-network notes for referrals, waitlists, and document deadlines.
Child-fit checklist for age, language, medical, social, and independence readiness.
Decision summary for partner or caregiver discussion.
sourceSignalReferences: S10 - New York Post, NYC parents send kids abroad to reduce summer-camp cost
S11 - Reddit r/nycparents, summer camp cost exhaustion
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype called "Camp Abroad Calculator" for working parents comparing summer childcare and camp options. Start on the decision workspace. Include a family summer calendar, camp comparison table, true-cost calculator, weekly coverage confidence meter, parent-network notes, child-fit checklist, and decision summary. Use realistic sample options such as local NYC day camp, sleepaway camp, Europe day camp, overseas swim camp, public lottery program, and shared caregiver. Design direction: use the premium-editorial profile with refined family-finance styling, elegant but readable typography, curated comparison cards, warm charcoal/stone tones, and one quiet CTA color.
